About / Disclaimer

Hey guys, after a lot of community demand and support for the previous pop report, we made this website to help people keep live track of the pop counts of prize cards easy and smooth, and not be overwhelmed or lost when it comes to learning about them since many people don't know where to look or how to check them. And other than just prize cards we want to make this a place where grail hunters and newcomers can easily find grails, so we also included the grail chases of every set and the iconic promo cards.

We tallied all the prize cards from every Regional, Nationals, World Championship and Treasure Cup below, including all the side events where some additional ones were given out like the side events during Regionals and Nationals, and have cited all the official sources of distribution for each card on the card's page and under the Citations tab.

Even though we tallied all the official distributions, there are some cards that got leaked, as with any TCG. Magic has leaked Alpha Black Lotus cards, Pokémon has a bunch of World Championship and even Illustrator cards that have been leaked, and so does Yu-Gi-Oh. It's part of every TCG, and even though it sucks it doesn't mean the cards themselves aren't valuable — look at the other TCGs for example. The leaks are real cards, made in case one gets damaged or lost, which make their way to the market.

Bandai has been getting better with time by arresting employees who were behind the leaks. The pop counts on grading sites like Beckett and PSA aren't correct either, since many of these cards have been re-submitted to try and get a higher grade — and even if only a few people do it, when the pops are this low it can cause a big hindrance in their report. Some have also been mislabeled by Beckett and PSA (non-textured event cards as a textured finalist), so you can't trust the grading pop reports either. The Kaido Nationals winner, for example, has been resubmitted over 20 times to try and get a black label, just from people we know.

Some cards have a few leaks while others do not, so as a general rule of thumb, assume the true pop accounting for leaks is 20–25%, or 10–15 cards, higher than the official pop mentioned below.

That's all — have fun hunting, collect the grails you love, and find your One Piece!
